appearance.extreme: They track you by smell alone with their eyes shut, and they tilt their head at sounds nobody else in the room can hear.
appearance.obvious: They keep scenting the air, and their eyes go to movement before it finishes happening.
appearance.subtle: Their nostrils flare when you come close.

description: Everything sharpened at once. You can smell blood through a wall and hear a heartbeat across a room, and you have started noticing that you enjoy it.
name: Predator's Senses
